# Subway Seat for foot

Colors, dim colors, cursor, selection, search box, jump labels, URLs and the bell flash. Each file has a dark and a light section (Enamel is the light side of the dark flavors, Walnut the dark side of Enamel). foot doesn't follow the desktop on its own: switch with the `color-theme-toggle` key binding (unbound by default), or send foot `SIGUSR1` for dark and `SIGUSR2` for light, for example from a darkman script.

[foot](https://codeberg.org/dnkl/foot) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/foot/) · Needs foot 1.26+

## The quick way

```sh
curl -fsSL https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/install.sh | sh -s -- --only foot
```

The [installer](../../docs/INSTALL.md) shows its plan and asks once. Add `--flavor tunnel`, `--flavor enamel` or `--flavor auto` for another flavor. To do it yourself, use the files below.

| London Portland | [`london-portland.ini`](london-portland.ini) | `~/.config/foot/london-portland.ini` |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in ~/.config/foot/foot.ini:

```ini
[main]
include=~/.config/foot/subway-seat.ini
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in ~/.config/foot/foot.ini:

```ini
[main]
include=~/.config/foot/subway-seat-tunnel.ini
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in ~/.config/foot/foot.ini:

```ini
[main]
include=~/.config/foot/subway-seat-enamel.ini
```

**London Moquette**, in ~/.config/foot/foot.ini:

```ini
[main]
include=~/.config/foot/london-moquette.ini
```

**London Deep Level**, in ~/.config/foot/foot.ini:

```ini

include=~/.config/foot/london-deep-level.ini
```

**London Portland**, in ~/.config/foot/foot.ini:

```ini

```

**Paris Guimard**, in ~/.config/foot/foot.ini:

```ini

```

**Paris Catacombes**, in ~/.config/foot/foot.ini:


**Paris Carrelage**, in ~/.config/foot/foot.ini:

## Uninstall

- Delete `~/.config/foot/subway-seat.ini`.
- Delete `~/.config/foot/subway-seat-tunnel.ini`.
- Delete `~/.config/foot/subway-seat-enamel.ini`.
- Delete `~/.config/foot/london-moquette.ini`.
- Delete `~/.config/foot/london-deep-level.ini`.
- Delete `~/.config/foot/london-portland.ini`.
- Delete `~/.config/foot/paris-guimard.ini`.
- Delete `~/.config/foot/paris-catacombes.ini`.
- Delete `~/.config/foot/paris-carrelage.ini`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.
